tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i brgyud 'debs bzhugs so//

khyab bdag ston pa kun bzang che ba'i mchog /rdo rje sems dpa' zhi khro bka' brgyad lha// rdo rje 'chang dbang shāka thub dga' rab la// gsol ba 'debs so dbang skur byin gyis rlobs// gsang chen bka' yi sdud po rdo rje chos// mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo las kyi dbang mo che// skal ldan mchog rab in+d+ra bhū ti la// gsol ba 'debs so dbang skur byin gyis rlobs// mi slob zung 'jug mngon gyur shrī siṃ ha// bde chen sgyu ma'i gar mkhan go ma sa// dzam gling rgyan mchog dpal gyi rig 'dzin brgyad// gsol ba 'debs so dbang skur byin gyis rlobs// rab 'byams rgyal kun ngo bo pad+ma 'byung*// gangs can bstan pa'i nyin byed grub chen brgyad// chos rgyal tshangs pa lha yi me tog la// gsol ba 'debs so dbang skur byin gyis rlobs// zab gter bstan pa'i spyi mes mnga' bdag nyang*// mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i mgon po nam mkha' dpal// snying po'i don gzigs blo ldan shes rab zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so= mthu stobs brtul zhugs mthar phyin bdud 'dul mtshan// sgrol mas rjes bzung mdo sde seng ge dang*// mkhas grub zla med pad+ma dngos grub la// gsol ba 'debs so= 'jam dpal grub pa'i dpa' bo nor bu'i mtshan// 'jig rten dbang phyug kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal// grub pa'i rig 'dzin nyang ston nor bu 'phel// gsol ba 'debs so= phan bdes kun tu dga' ba'i 'od zer can// 'khrul zhig rje rigs nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pa// gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇa chen pad+ma dbang*// gsol ba 'debs so dbang skur byin gyis rlobs// lha sras rnam rol rin chen phun tshogs zhabs// gar dbang ye shes mchog gi rol pa rtsal// blo gros mchog gis bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin// gsol ba 'debs so= gzhan phan phrin las mthar phyin rdo rje 'dzin// gar dbang mgon po phrin las lhun grub dang*// pad+ma gar dbang 'gyur med rdo rje la// gsol ba 'debs so=

phrin las grub pa'i rdo rje 'gro 'dul rtsal// hūm̐ mdzad rol pa rdo rje'i gter mdzod 'dzin// dbang bzhi'i rgyal mtshan mdzes pa'i rdo rje'i tog /gsol ba 'debs so= bsam gtan rgya mtshor ye shes rin chen 'phel// kun bzang gdung 'tshob phrin las lhun gyis grub// nges don chos kyi srid skyong gar gyi dbang*// gsol ba 'debs so= kha skong sh+lo ka gnyis gu ṇas so// dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag chos kyi rje// smin grol gdams pa'i bdun rtsi mchog sbyin mkhan// bka' drin mnyam med rtsa brgyud bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so dbang skur byin gyis rlobs// phyi dkyil smin byed lam gyis lha skur shar// lus dkyil dbang gis rtsa khams bde drod 'bar// phyag rgya la bsten dga' bzhi'i ye shes rtogs// rang sems ka dag kun bzang mngon gyur shog / ces rgyal khams pa 'gyur med rdo rjes so/// /
